research_direction: Direction 6 (paper-grounded, Model Spec Midtraining, arXiv:2605.02087) at 1B: midtrain on documents that ARGUE for a general maintenance disposition and name sub-rules; SFT on rows that demonstrate the behaviour in ONE narrow unrelated setting without stating any general rule; measure in 24 settings present in NEITHER corpus. The interaction term is then literally 'how much further the narrow SFT generalizes when the earlier stage supplied a frame'.
